theorem elem_of_rejected (votes : GMap w64 Bool) (k : w64) : k ∈ rejected votes ↔ votes !! k = some
    false

def ownIdsetQ (m : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (ids : GMap w64 Unit) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜m = map.nil ∧ ids = ∅⌝ ∨ ownMap m dq ids)

def ownIdsetOpt (m : Loc) (ids : GMap w64 Unit) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜m = map.nil ∧ ids = ∅⌝ ∨ ownMap m (DFrac.own 1) ids)

theorem ownProgress_intro [package_sem : Assumptions] (pr : Loc) (pv : tracker.Progress) (p :
    Progress) : ⊢ typedPointsto pr pv (DFrac.own 1) -∗ ownInflights pv.Inflights' p.infl -∗
    ⌜progressAbs pv p.infl = some p⌝ -∗ ownProgress pr p

theorem progressOf.proj_next (pv : tracker.Progress) (st : PRState) (i : Inflights) : (progressOf pv
    st i).next = pv.Next'

theorem nsat_le (P : w64 → Prop) [(k : w64) → Decidable (P k)] (l : List w64) : nsat P l ≤ l.length

theorem ownIdsetC_nil [package_sem : Assumptions] (dq : DFrac) : ⊢ ownIdsetC map.nil dq ∅

theorem cfg_minus_rejected (cfg : GSet w64) (votes : GMap w64 Bool) : cfg \ rejected votes = granted
    votes ∩ cfg ∪ cfg \ votes.domSet

theorem nsat_snoc (P : w64 → Prop) [(k : w64) → Decidable (P k)] (l : List w64) (k : w64) : nsat P
    (l ++ [k]) = nsat P l + if P k then 1 else 0

def pvsMatchAt (pvs : GMap w64 Progress) (v : w64) : w64 :=
  (pvsAcked pvs v).getD (W64 0)

def ownProgressMap (m : Loc) (pvs : GMap w64 Progress) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ prs, "#Hprs" ∷ ownMap m DFrac.discard prs ∗ "Hprogs" ∷ [∗map] pr;p ∈ prs;pvs, ownProgress pr p)

theorem ownConfig_values [package_sem : Assumptions] (cfg : GSet w64) (cfgv : tracker.Config) (prsm
    : Loc) (prs : GMap w64 Loc) : ownConfig cfg cfgv prsm prs ⊢ ∃ pvs, ownConfigV cfg cfgv prsm prs
    pvs

def nsat (P : w64 → Prop) [(k : w64) → Decidable (P k)] (l : List w64) : Nat :=
  (List.filter (fun k => decide (P k)) l).length

def pvsAcked (pvs : GMap w64 Progress) (v : w64) : Option w64 :=
  Progress.matched <$> pvs !! v

theorem ownIdsetC_insert [package_sem : Assumptions] (m : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (ids : GMap w64 Unit) (k
    : w64) : ownMap m dq <[k := ()]>ids ⊢ ownIdsetC m dq <[k := ()]>ids

theorem ownInflights_intro [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (r : InflightsRing) : ⊢
    ownInflightsRaw l r -∗ ownInflights l r.win

def ownConfig (cfg : GSet w64) (cfgv : tracker.Config) (prsm : Loc) (prs : GMap w64 Loc) : IProp GF
    :=
  iprop(∃ pvs, ownConfigV cfg cfgv prsm prs pvs)

theorem ownIdsetC_empty_nil [package_sem : Assumptions] (m : Loc) (dq : DFrac) : ownIdsetC m dq ∅ ⊢
    ⌜m = map.nil⌝

theorem progressOf.proj_sentCommit (pv : tracker.Progress) (st : PRState) (i : Inflights) :
    (progressOf pv st i).sentCommit = pv.sentCommit'

theorem ownConfig_restore [package_sem : Assumptions] (cfg lrn : GSet w64) (cfgv : tracker.Config)
    (prsm : Loc) (prs : GMap w64 Loc) (vref : Loc) (vm : GMap w64 Unit) (Hcfgarr : cfgv.Voters'.arr
    = [vref, map.nil]) (Hcfgln : cfgv.LearnersNext' = map.nil) (Hcfgal : cfgv.AutoLeave' = false)
    (Hvm : vm.domSet = cfg) (Hprs : prs.domSet = cfg ∪ lrn) (Hd : ∀ (k : w64), k ∈ lrn → ¬k ∈ cfg)
    (Hcsz : ↑(cfg ∪ lrn).size ≤ 2 ^ 62) : ⊢ ownMap vref (DFrac.own 1) vm -∗ ownIdsetC cfgv.Learners'
    (DFrac.own 1) lrn -∗ ownMap prsm DFrac.discard prs -∗ ([∗map] k ↦ pr ∈ prs, iprop(∃ p,
    ownProgress pr p ∗ ⌜p.learner = !decide (k ∈ cfg)⌝)) -∗ ownConfig cfg cfgv prsm prs

theorem nsat_missing (cfg : GSet w64) (votes : GMap w64 Bool) (keys : List w64) (Hnd : keys.Nodup)
    (Hset : listToSet keys = cfg) : nsat (fun k => votes !! k = none) keys = (cfg \
    votes.domSet).size

theorem inflightsRingOf.proj_win (iv : tracker.Inflights) (buf : List tracker.inflight) :
    (inflightsRingOf iv buf).win = inflightsAbs iv

theorem isAckedIndexer_pers (l : GoInterface) (P : IProp GF) (acked : w64 → Option w64) : Persistent
    (isAckedIndexer l P acked)

theorem ownIdsetC_Q [package_sem : Assumptions] (m : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (ids : GMap w64 Unit) :
    ownIdsetC m dq ids ⊢ ownIdsetQ m dq ids

def ownProgress (pr : Loc) (p : Progress) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ pv,
      "Hpv" ∷ typedPointsto pr pv (DFrac.own 1) ∗
        "Hinfl" ∷ ownInflights pv.Inflights' p.infl ∗ "%Habs" ∷ ⌜progressAbs pv p.infl = some p⌝)

theorem pm_insert_gmap {V : Type} (m : GMap w64 V) (k : w64) (v : V) : Std.insert m k v = <[k :=
    v]>m

theorem inflightsRingOf.proj_start (iv : tracker.Inflights) (buf : List tracker.inflight) :
    (inflightsRingOf iv buf).start = sint.Z iv.start'

theorem ownIdsetQ_not_nil [package_sem : Assumptions] (m : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (ids : GMap w64 Unit)
    (H : m ≠ map.nil) : ownIdsetQ m dq ids ⊢ ownMap m dq ids

def progressOf (pv : tracker.Progress) (st : PRState) (i : Inflights) : Progress :=
  { matched := pv.Match', next := pv.Next', sentCommit := pv.sentCommit', state := st,
    pendingSnapshot := pv.PendingSnapshot', paused := pv.MsgAppFlowPaused', infl := i, learner := pv.IsLearner' }

theorem ownIdsetC_nil_of [package_sem : Assumptions] (m : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (ids : GMap w64 Unit) (H
    : ids = ∅) : ownIdsetC m dq ids ⊢ ⌜m = map.nil⌝

theorem progressOf.proj_paused (pv : tracker.Progress) (st : PRState) (i : Inflights) : (progressOf
    pv st i).paused = pv.MsgAppFlowPaused'

def MatchKept (old pvs : GMap w64 Progress) : Prop :=
  ∀ (k : w64) (p' : Progress),
    pvs !! k = some p' → uint.Z p'.matched = 0 ∨ ∃ p, old !! k = some p ∧ p.matched = p'.matched

def ownInflights (l : Loc) (i : Inflights) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ r, "Hin" ∷ ownInflightsRaw l r ∗ "%Hiabs" ∷ ⌜r.win = i⌝)

theorem IsQuorum_alt (cfg q : GSet w64) : IsQuorum cfg q ↔ GMap.size cfg / 2 + 1 ≤ (q ∩ cfg).size

def LearnersOk (cfg : GSet w64) (prs : GMap w64 Loc) (pvs : GMap w64 Progress) (learners
    learnersNext : GMap w64 Unit) : Prop :=
  learners.domSet = prs.domSet \ cfg ∧ learnersNext = ∅ ∧ LearnerFlags cfg pvs

def IsQuorumIndex (s : GSet w64) (f : w64 → w64) (N : w64) : Prop :=
  (∃ v, v ∈ s ∧ f v = N) ∧
    IsQuorum s (GMap.filter (fun v x => decide (uint.Z N ≤ uint.Z (f v))) s) ∧
      ∀ (N' : w64), uint.Z N < uint.Z N' → ¬IsQuorum s (GMap.filter (fun v x => decide (uint.Z N' ≤ uint.Z (f v))) s)

def InflightsOk (r : InflightsRing) : Prop :=
  0 ≤ r.start ∧
    (0 ≤ r.win.count ∧ r.win.count ≤ r.win.size) ∧
      (0 ≤ r.buflen ∧ r.buflen ≤ r.win.size) ∧
        r.win.size < 2 ^ 62 ∧
          (r.start < r.win.size ∨ r.win.size = 0 ∧ r.start = 0) ∧
            (r.start + r.win.count ≤ r.buflen ∨ r.buflen = r.win.size)

theorem wp_mapDelete_named [package_sem : Assumptions] {V : Type} [ZeroVal V] (t key_type elem_type
    : go.GoType) [h : go.UnderlyingDirectedEq t (key_type.MapType elem_type)] (l : Loc) (m : GMap
    w64 V) (k : w64) [SafeMapKey key_type k] : ⊢ ∀ Φ, ownMap l (DFrac.own 1) m -∗ ▷ (ownMap l
    (DFrac.own 1) (GMap.delete k m) -∗ Φ (intoVal ())) -∗ WP (((intoVal (functions go.delete [t]))
    (intoVal l)) (intoVal k)) {{ Φ }}

theorem granted_missing_disjoint (cfg : GSet w64) (votes : GMap w64 Bool) : (granted votes ∩
    cfg).Disjoint (cfg \ votes.domSet)

theorem progressOf.proj_infl (pv : tracker.Progress) (st : PRState) (i : Inflights) : (progressOf pv
    st i).infl = i

theorem progressOf.proj_state (pv : tracker.Progress) (st : PRState) (i : Inflights) : (progressOf
    pv st i).state = st

theorem inflightsRingOf.proj_buflen (iv : tracker.Inflights) (buf : List tracker.inflight) :
    (inflightsRingOf iv buf).buflen = ↑buf.length

syntax tacticProgress_abs_solve

def ownConfigV (cfg : GSet w64) (cfgv : tracker.Config) (prsm : Loc) (prs : GMap w64 Loc) (pvs :
    GMap w64 Progress) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ vref vm learners,
      "%Hcfgarr" ∷ ⌜cfgv.Voters'.arr = [vref, map.nil]⌝ ∗
        "Hcfgl" ∷ ownIdsetC cfgv.Learners' (DFrac.own 1) learners ∗
          "%Hcfgln" ∷ ⌜cfgv.LearnersNext' = map.nil⌝ ∗
            "%Hcfgal" ∷ ⌜cfgv.AutoLeave' = false⌝ ∗
              "Hvref" ∷ ownMap vref (DFrac.own 1) vm ∗
                "%Hvm" ∷ ⌜vm.domSet = cfg⌝ ∗
                  "#Hprsm" ∷ ownMap prsm DFrac.discard prs ∗
                    "%Hprs" ∷ ⌜cfg ⊆ prs.domSet⌝ ∗
                      ("Hprogs" ∷ [∗map] pr;p ∈ prs;pvs, ownProgress pr p) ∗
                        "%Hlrn" ∷ ⌜LearnersOk cfg prs pvs learners ∅⌝ ∗ "%Hcsz" ∷ ⌜↑prs.size ≤ 2 ^ 62⌝)

theorem wp_idset_lookup2 [package_sem : Assumptions] (m : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (s : GMap w64 Unit) (k :
    w64) : ⊢ ∀ Φ, ownIdsetQ m dq s -∗ ▷ (ownIdsetQ m dq s -∗ Φ (intoVal (), intoVal (decide ((s !!
    k).isSome = true)))) -∗ WP (((map.lookup2 go.uint64 (go.StructType [])) (intoVal m)) (intoVal
    k)) {{ Φ }}

def inflightsRingOf (iv : tracker.Inflights) (buf : List tracker.inflight) : InflightsRing :=
  { win := inflightsAbs iv, start := sint.Z iv.start', buflen := ↑buf.length }

theorem ownIdsetC_split [package_sem : Assumptions] (m : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (ids : GMap w64 Unit) :
    ownIdsetC m dq ids ⊢ ownIdsetQ m dq ids ∗ ⌜m = map.nil ∨ ids ≠ ∅⌝

theorem wp_max2_uint64 [package_sem : Assumptions] (x y : w64) : ⊢ ∀ Φ, True -∗ ▷ (True -∗ Φ
    (intoVal (w64Max x y))) -∗ WP (((intoVal (functions go.max [go.uint64, go.uint64])) (intoVal x))
    (intoVal y)) {{ Φ }}

theorem ownIdsetQ_nil [package_sem : Assumptions] (dq : DFrac) : ⊢ ownIdsetQ map.nil dq ∅

theorem array_acc_same [package_sem : Assumptions] {V : Type} [ZeroVal V] [TypedPointsto V] (p :
    Loc) (i : Int) (dq : DFrac) (n : Int) (a : GoArray V n) (v : V) (hpos : 0 ≤ i) (hlookup :
    a.arr[i.toNat]? = some v) : typedPointsto p a dq ⊢ typedPointsto (arrayIndexRef V i p) v dq ∗
    (typedPointsto (arrayIndexRef V i p) v dq -∗ typedPointsto p a dq)

theorem inflightsFull_abs (iv : tracker.Inflights) : inflightsFull (inflightsAbs iv) = (decide
    (iv.count' = iv.size') || decide (iv.maxBytes' ≠ W64 0) && decide (uint.Z iv.maxBytes' ≤ uint.Z
    iv.bytes'))

def ownIdsetC (m : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (ids : GMap w64 Unit) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜m = map.nil ∧ ids = ∅⌝ ∨ ownMap m dq ids ∗ ⌜ids ≠ ∅⌝)

theorem ownIdsetQ_map [package_sem : Assumptions] (m : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (ids : GMap w64 Unit) :
    ownMap m dq ids ⊢ ownIdsetQ m dq ids

theorem nsat_size (cfg Y : GSet w64) (keys : List w64) (P : w64 → Prop) [(k : w64) → Decidable (P
    k)] (HY : ∀ (k : w64), k ∈ cfg → (k ∈ Y ↔ P k)) (Hsub : Y ⊆ cfg) (Hnd : keys.Nodup) (Hset :
    listToSet keys = cfg) : nsat P keys = GMap.size Y

def LearnerFlags (cfg : GSet w64) (pvs : GMap w64 Progress) : Prop :=
  ∀ (k : w64) (p : Progress), pvs !! k = some p → p.learner = decide ¬k ∈ cfg

structure InflightsRing : Type where
  win : Inflights
  start : Int
  buflen : Int

theorem ownIdsetC_join [package_sem : Assumptions] (m : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (ids : GMap w64 Unit) (H :
    m = map.nil ∨ ids ≠ ∅) : ownIdsetQ m dq ids ⊢ ownIdsetC m dq ids

theorem progress_map_agree [package_sem : Assumptions] (mref : Loc) (dq1 dq2 : DFrac) (m1 m2 : GMap
    w64 Loc) : ⊢ ownMap mref dq1 m1 -∗ ownMap mref dq2 m2 -∗ ⌜m1 = m2⌝

theorem wp_min2_uint64 [package_sem : Assumptions] (x y : w64) : ⊢ ∀ Φ, True -∗ ▷ (True -∗ Φ
    (intoVal (w64Min x y))) -∗ WP (((intoVal (functions go.min [go.uint64, go.uint64])) (intoVal x))
    (intoVal y)) {{ Φ }}

theorem ownInflights_reseal [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (iv : tracker.Inflights) (buf :
    List tracker.inflight) (i : Inflights) : ⊢ typedPointsto l iv (DFrac.own 1) -∗ ownSlice
    iv.buffer' buf (DFrac.own 1) -∗ ownSliceCap tracker.inflight iv.buffer' (DFrac.own 1) -∗
    ⌜InflightsOk (inflightsRingOf iv buf) ∧ inflightsAbs iv = i⌝ -∗ ownInflights l i

theorem wp_ProgressMap_len [package_sem : Assumptions] (mref : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (m : GMap w64 Loc)
    : ⊢ ∀ Φ, ownMap mref dq m -∗ ▷ (ownMap mref dq m -∗ Φ (intoVal (W64 ↑m.size))) -∗ WP ((intoVal
    (functions go.len [tracker.ProgressMap.ty])) (intoVal mref)) {{ Φ }}

theorem ownProgress_of [package_sem : Assumptions] (pr : Loc) (pv : tracker.Progress) (st : PRState)
    (i : Inflights) (Hst : pv.State' = prstateW64 st) : ⊢ typedPointsto pr pv (DFrac.own 1) -∗
    ownInflights pv.Inflights' i -∗ ownProgress pr (progressOf pv st i)

theorem nsat_granted (cfg : GSet w64) (votes : GMap w64 Bool) (keys : List w64) (Hnd : keys.Nodup)
    (Hset : listToSet keys = cfg) : nsat (fun k => votes !! k = some true) keys = (granted votes ∩
    cfg).size

theorem size_cfg_minus_rejected (cfg : GSet w64) (votes : GMap w64 Bool) : (cfg \ rejected
    votes).size = (granted votes ∩ cfg).size + (cfg \ votes.domSet).size

theorem ownInflightsRaw_intro [package_sem : Assumptions] (l : Loc) (iv : tracker.Inflights) (buf :
    List tracker.inflight) : ⊢ typedPointsto l iv (DFrac.own 1) -∗ ownSlice iv.buffer' buf
    (DFrac.own 1) -∗ ownSliceCap tracker.inflight iv.buffer' (DFrac.own 1) -∗ ⌜InflightsOk
    (inflightsRingOf iv buf)⌝ -∗ ownInflightsRaw l (inflightsRingOf iv buf)

theorem progressOf.proj_pendingSnapshot (pv : tracker.Progress) (st : PRState) (i : Inflights) :
    (progressOf pv st i).pendingSnapshot = pv.PendingSnapshot'

theorem progressOf.proj_matched (pv : tracker.Progress) (st : PRState) (i : Inflights) : (progressOf
    pv st i).matched = pv.Match'

theorem bigSepM_exist_sepM2 {A B : Type} (m : GMap w64 A) (Φ : w64 → A → B → IProp GF) : ⊢ ([∗map] k
    ↦ x ∈ m, iprop(∃ y, Φ k x y)) -∗ ∃ m', [∗map] k ↦ x;y ∈ m;m', Φ k x y

theorem ownIdsetQ_nil_empty [package_sem : Assumptions] (m : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (ids : GMap w64 Unit)
    : ownIdsetQ m dq ids ⊢ ownIdsetQ m dq ids ∗ ⌜m = map.nil → ids = ∅⌝

theorem progressOf.proj_learner (pv : tracker.Progress) (st : PRState) (i : Inflights) : (progressOf
    pv st i).learner = pv.IsLearner'

def isAckedIndexer (l : GoInterface) (P : IProp GF) (acked : w64 → Option w64) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ i,
      "%Hlok" ∷ ⌜l = GoInterface.ok i⌝ ∗
        "#HAckedIndex" ∷
          □
            ∀ id,
              □
                ∀ Φ,
                  P -∗
                    ▷ (P -∗ Φ (intoVal ((acked id).getD (W64 0)), intoVal (acked id).isSome)) -∗
                      WP
                        ((intoVal (methods i.ty go!"AckedIndex" i.v))
                          (intoVal id))
                        {{ Φ }})

theorem pm_delete_gmap {V : Type} (m : GMap w64 V) (k : w64) : Std.delete m k = GMap.delete k m

theorem wp_idset_len [package_sem : Assumptions] {t key_type elem_type : go.GoType} [go.IsUnderlying
    t (key_type.MapType elem_type)] (m : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (s : GMap w64 Unit) : ⊢ ∀ Φ, ownIdsetQ m
    dq s -∗ ▷ (ownIdsetQ m dq s ∗ ⌜s.size < 2 ^ 63⌝ -∗ Φ (intoVal (W64 ↑s.size))) -∗ WP ((intoVal
    (functions go.len [t])) (intoVal m)) {{ Φ }}

theorem wp_idset_for_range [package_sem : Assumptions] (P : List w64 → Int → IProp GF) (body :
    GoFunc) (m : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (s : GMap w64 Unit) (Φ : val → IProp GF) : ⊢ ownIdsetQ m dq s -∗
    (∀ keys, ⌜(∀ (k : w64), k ∈ keys ↔ (s !! k).isSome = true) ∧ keys.length = s.size ∧ keys.Nodup⌝
    -∗ P keys 0 ∗ (□ ∀ i key v, ⌜keys[i.toNat]? = some key ∧ s !! key = some v⌝ -∗ P keys i -∗ WP
    (((intoVal body) (intoVal key)) (intoVal v)) {{ v, forMapPostcondition (P keys (i + 1)) (fun v
    => iprop(ownIdsetQ m dq s -∗ Φ v)) v }}) ∗ (P keys ↑s.size -∗ ownIdsetQ m dq s -∗ Φ executeVal))
    -∗ WP (((map.forRange go.uint64 (go.StructType [])) (intoVal m)) (intoVal body)) {{ Φ }}

def ownInflightsRaw (l : Loc) (r : InflightsRing) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ iv buf,
      "Hiv" ∷ typedPointsto l iv (DFrac.own 1) ∗
        "Hbuf" ∷ ownSlice iv.buffer' buf (DFrac.own 1) ∗
          "Hbuf_cap" ∷ ownSliceCap tracker.inflight iv.buffer' (DFrac.own 1) ∗
            "%Hring" ∷ ⌜r = inflightsRingOf iv buf⌝ ∗ "%Hinfl_ok" ∷ ⌜InflightsOk r⌝)

theorem ownIdsetQ_elim [package_sem : Assumptions] (m : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (ids : GMap w64 Unit) :
    ownIdsetQ m dq ids ⊢ ⌜m = map.nil ∧ ids = ∅⌝ ∨ ownMap m dq ids
